name: hush
description: The Energy fleet's secrets-management domain-expert employee — issue/store/scan/rotate/scrub/inject/broker secrets and prevent agents from leaking them. hush scans a repo for leaked secrets and exits nonzero on a finding, gives the real (rotate-first, scrub-second) remediation, wires a scanner/SOPS+age setup, and brokers short-TTL credential handles — always returning handles, never raw values (O-09). It refuses the false-greens (git rm --cached, sops updatekeys-only, GCP 'rotation enabled') and refuses to quote a single price. Boundary: not auth/sign-in/identity (that's badge — hush consumes a machine identity, never owns one, O-15). Tagline: Issued, never leaked. Rotated, then proven. Powered by Energy.

additionalInterfaces.note: hush is a stdio-local tool-employee for C1 (no hosted endpoint — PLAN HS-1). Every capability round-trips through the local CLI (`node bin/hush ...`) or the stdio MCP server (`node dist/mcp/server.js`, tool `hush_<capability>`). Scanning runs offline against the local repo.
JSON-RPC over stdio; tools/list returns hush_scan, hush_doctor, hush_advise, hush_remediate, hush_rotate_plan, hush_broker, hush_tool. Resources: hush://brain/* (read-only doctrine).

hardInvariant: Every capability returns a handle/reference or a verdict — never a `value` field, never a secret-shaped string (O-09).

skills.name: Scan a repo for leaked secrets
skills.description: Run the scanning stack (gitleaks prevent/catch + trufflehog verify + .mcp.json literal check + base64). Exit nonzero on any finding; findings are redacted (no raw value). THE acceptance capability.
examples: Scan this repo's history for a leaked API key.
Is there a secret in my .mcp.json?

skills.name: Report a repo's secret-manager wiring
skills.description: Return the wiring report for a repo: gitignore_ok, env_example_schema_only, mcp_refs_ok, scanners_present, sops_breakglass, score. Booleans only, never values.
examples: Is this repo set up to keep secrets out of git?

skills.name: Verdict + doctrine for a remediation question
skills.description: Return a verdict + the correct doctrine; flags false-greens (git rm --cached, updatekeys-only, GCP 'rotation enabled'). Returns { verdict, doctrine, false_green, brain_refs }.
examples: I ran git rm --cached on the leaked .env — am I clean now?

skills.name: Ordered rotate-first remediation plan
skills.description: Produce the ordered rotate-first plan for a finding (rotate_first:true, consent_required_for_scrub:true). Never auto-rewrites history off an unverified line number (P-04).
examples: A key was committed to history — what's the real fix, in order?

skills.name: Return a short-TTL handle for a secret
skills.description: Return a handle hush://store/<name> + expiresAt and log the handoff — NEVER the value (O-09). Delivery of the value to a child process happens via `hush inject`.
examples: Give my agent access to the DB password without putting it in the transcript.

skills.name: Recommend the secrets portfolio for a job
skills.description: Recommend the portfolio/layer for a job (OpenBao default; SOPS+age for git). Never quotes a single price (G-01). Returns { default, alts, when_alt, billing_note, brain_refs }.
examples: What should I use for short-lived DB credentials?
How should I encrypt secrets in git?
